comments.text:
Imagine paying $3 for a street meal in Istanbul… while the person serving it struggles to keep up with the rent.
That's the side of life in Turkey most tourists never see, and it's only the beginning of this Turkey documentary. Wait until you see what's hidden 280 feet beneath Cappadocia. 🏛
Tell us in the comments, and subscribe so you don't miss our next country. 🙏
